subject: MPA lighthouse: legal & procurement dependencies for pilot onboarding
messages:
From: Elise Ramos <elise.ramos@novacare.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Haines <thaines@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPA & legal sequencing for Redwood pilot — dependencies and target dates

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to pilot Redwood for inference routing on our clinical summarization workflow. Procurement asked me to pull together a short list of gating items and target dates so we can map a mutual action plan. High-level asks from our side: 

- Signed MSA + DPA + order form in place by 2026-09-10 (we need procurement paperwork to enable pilot licensing).
- SOC 2 / security evidence and a short runbook for restricted data handling (required for legal and InfoSec).
- Acceptance criteria and a short test plan for the 2-week pilot (what constitutes successful handoff).

Can you share a suggested sequencing (legal review windows, procurement PO timing, and technical enablement durations)? We can be flexible but the business wants visibility on dates and owners. I attached our initial MAP spreadsheet for your reference.

Attachments: Novacare_Request_MAP.xlsx

Thanks,
Elise
Elise Ramos
Director, Clinical AI Programs
Novacare
elise.ramos@novacare.com

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Ramos <elise.ramos@novacare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Tom Haines <thaines@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA & legal sequencing for Redwood pilot — dependencies and target dates

Elise — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP spreadsheet. We put together a lightweight "MPA lighthouse" that maps dependencies (legal, procurement, security evidence, and technical milestones) and recommended target windows based on typical customers. I've attached our draft (Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a copy of the DPA with our suggested redlines (DPA_redlines_20260803.docx) so legal can see the starting point.

High-level sequencing (recommended):
- Legal review (MSA + DPA): target 7 business days from receipt of prioritized redlines. If Novacare can flag a small set of priority clauses we can compress to 3–4 days.
- Procurement PO / order form clearance: 3–5 business days after legal OKs terms.
- Technical enablement & pilot prep (infra, data connectors, scoped eval prompts): 7–10 business days in parallel with PO processing.
- Acceptance testing window: 10 business days for a 2-week pilot (we'll define acceptance tests up front).

Proposed milestone dates if we start today (2026-08-04):
- Legal complete (target): 2026-08-13
- PO signed & order form: 2026-08-18
- Pilot kickoff: 2026-08-24
- Pilot completion & review: 2026-09-07

Owners (internal):
- Legal & DPA: Karthik Iyer (Legal)
- Security evidence & SOC2: Rachel Kim (Security)
- Technical onboarding & pilot runbooks: Grace O'Connor (Customer Success / Onboarding)

Two asks from our side:
1) Please confirm the prioritized legal clauses or any required addenda (IP, data locality, indemnity caps).
2) Share the procurement contact who will own the PO and the target billing entity/contract name.

If those look OK, Karthik will do an initial pass on the DPA and we can schedule a 30-minute contract call to finalize outstanding items.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx, DPA_redlines_20260803.docx

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Elise Ramos <elise.ramos@novacare.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA lighthouse: legal & procurement dependencies for pilot onboarding

Thanks — looping in legal notes. Quick read from my side:

- I can turn a redline pass on the DPA in ~4 business days if the changes are limited to a few sections (data use, subprocessor list, and security standards). If Novacare needs bilateral changes across indemnity/cap limits, that will add time.
- For KMS/encryption specifics: we need to confirm whether Novacare requires a customer-managed key (HSM/KMS) vs. standard managed encryption. Please flag that early.
- I'm proposing a 30-minute contract review tomorrow (Thu 2026-08-06 at 09:00 PT) to walk through the prioritized items; I can host a screenshare and go live in DocuSign to record agreed edits.

Attachment: dpa-commented.pdf (high-level callouts; not exhaustive).

If procurement needs a short-term interim MSA (to allow pilot data movement while we complete DPA), we can explore a limited-scope pilot addendum — but we prefer to lock the DPA before production traffic.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

---

From: Elise Ramos <elise.ramos@novacare.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Haines <thaines@novacare.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA lighthouse: legal & procurement dependencies for pilot onboarding

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few updates from procurement and InfoSec: 

- Procurement contact: Tom Haines (thaines@novacare.com) will own the PO and order form. The contracting entity will be Novacare Health Systems, Inc.
- InfoSec asked for our SOC 2 attestation and a couple short runbooks (data flows + pseudonymization steps). I've attached our security QA sheet so you can see the fields they need.
- On the legal side, we can prioritize the DPA sections Karthik highlighted: data use, subprocessors, and security obligations. We need a firm DPA sign date by 2026-08-12 to hit our internal go/no-go. Is that possible?

We can push for a compressed review internally if Redwood can commit an accelerated legal turn (3 business days) and provide a marked DPA with comments in DocuSign. If Redwood needs the full 7 days, we may have to move the pilot start into early September.

Attachments: Novacare_Security_QA.xlsx

On a pragmatic note: we can accept an interim MSA with an explicit clause that pilot traffic is limited and non-PHI until the DPA is finalized. That would let us begin smoke tests while legal completes the DPA. Would Redwood agree to that pattern?

Thanks,
Elise

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Ramos <elise.ramos@novacare.com>, Tom Haines <thaines@novacare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA lighthouse: legal & procurement dependencies for pilot onboarding

Elise / Tom — great, thanks for the clarity. Confirming next steps and owners below so we have a single source of truth in the MAP lighthouse: 

Milestones & owners (agreed):
- DPA prioritized redlines submitted by Novacare: owner = Elise (target: EOD 2026-08-06)
- Legal redline pass (Redwood): owner = Karthik (target: 3 business days from receipt if redlines are limited)
- SOC2 + evidence handoff: owner = Rachel (I will share our SOC2 snapshot and a short runbook by EOD 2026-08-07).
- PO & order form approval: owner = Tom Haines / Novacare Procurement (target: 2026-08-18)
- Pilot kickoff (smoke tests only if interim MSA): owner = Grace (target: 2026-08-24 or earlier if interim MSA is accepted)

Commitments from Redwood:
- We can do the accelerated legal pass (3 business days) provided Novacare delivers a narrow set of prioritized redlines tonight (clauses we discussed).
- We will provide a SOC2 snapshot + short runbook (data handling + pseudonymization) and a secure link to evidence: https://redwood-secure.example.com/soc2/novacare (temporary access token will be issued to InfoSec).
- If Novacare uses an interim MSA for limited pilot traffic (non-PHI), Redwood will sign a short pilot addendum agreeing to the restrictions; full DPA must be signed before any PHI or production traffic.

I'll update the Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx with these owners and target dates and share an updated link to the MAP in HubSpot once it's in place. Proposed timeslot for contract review: Thu 2026-08-06 09:00 PT as Karthik suggested — I've put a calendar hold.

If that all looks good, Elise please confirm prioritized DPA clauses and procurement PO owner (Tom confirmed above). Once we have those, Karthik will post the redline pass and we can move forward on scheduling the pilot.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this scoped.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx
